```{r}


plot_shift_with_hist_qty <- function(coef_data, variables, type, matched, custom_colors){
  

  plot_data <- coef_data %>% 
    filter(variable %in% variables) %>% 
    mutate(#estimate = ifelse(variable == "global_tilted_irradiance", estimate*10, estimate)
           pretty_variable = case_when(
      variable == "renewable_day_ahead_forecast" ~ "Renewable Day-ahead Forecast (MWh)",
      variable == "global_tilted_irradiance_supply" ~ "Solar Irradiance (W/m2)",
      variable == "wind_speed_100m_supply" ~ "Wind Speed (m/s)",
      variable == "global_tilted_irradiance_supply" ~ "Solar Irradiance (W/m2)",
      variable == "wind_speed_100m_supply_bis" ~ "Supply Wind Speed (m/s)",
      variable == "global_tilted_irradiance_supply_bis" ~ "Supply Solar Irradiance (W/m2)",
      variable == "wind_speed_100m_demand" ~ "Demand Wind Speed (m/s)",
      variable == "global_tilted_irradiance_demand" ~ "Demand Solar Irradiance (W/m2)",
      # variable == "unpredicted_renewables" ~ "Unpredicted Renewables (MWh)",
      # variable == "intraday_update_renewables" ~ "Intraday Update Renewables (MWh)",
      variable == "intraday_update_wind" ~ "Intraday Update Wind (MWh)",
      variable == "intraday_update_sun" ~ "Intraday Update Solar (MWh)",
      variable == "unpredicted_wind" ~ "Unpredicted Wind (MWh)",
      variable == "unpredicted_sun" ~ "Unpredicted Solar (MWh)",
      variable == "cbf_es" ~ "CBF (MWh)",
      variable == "Fore_Wind" ~ "Wind Day-ahead Forecast (MWh)",
      variable == "Fore_Solar" ~ "Solar Day-ahead Forecast (MWh)",
      variable == "cold_excess_supply" ~ "Excess Cold (°C)",
      variable == "heat_excess_supply" ~ "Excess Heat (°C)",
      variable == "cold_excess_ss" ~ "Excess Cold PV (°C)",
      variable == "heat_excess_ss" ~ "Excess Heat PV (°C)",
      variable == "cold_excess_sth" ~ "Excess Cold Th (°C)",
      variable == "heat_excess_sth" ~ "Excess Heat Th (°C)",
      variable == "cold_excess_demand" ~ "Excess Cold Demand (°C)",
      variable == "heat_excess_demand" ~ "Excess Heat Demand (°C)",
      variable == "temperature_discomfort_ss" ~ "Local PV Temperature Deviation (°C)",
      variable == "temperature_discomfort_sth" ~ "Local Th Temperature Deviation (°C)",
      variable == "temperature_discomfort_demand" ~ "Local Temperature Deviation",
      variable == "temperature_discomfort_demand_bis" ~ "Local Temperature Deviation Demand Effect",
      variable =="temp_spatial_mismatch_supply"~ "Spatial Mismatch Temperature Supply Effect",
      variable =="temp_spatial_mismatch_supply_bis"~ "Spatial Mismatch Temperature Demand Effect",
      variable == "temperature_discomfort_supply" ~ "Local Temperature Deviation Supply Effect",
      variable == "temperature_discomfort_supply_bis" ~ "Local Temperature Deviation Demand Effect",
      variable =="temp_spatial_mismatch_demand"~ "Spatial Mismatch Temperature Supply Effect",
      variable =="temp_spatial_mismatch_demand_bis"~ "Spatial Mismatch Temperature Demand Effect",
      variable == "Published.Unavailable.Capacity" ~ "Plant Unavailability (MWh)",
      variable == "Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity" ~ "Nuclear Unavailability (MWh)",
      variable == "Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity" ~ "Effective Unavailability (MWh)",
      variable == "Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity" ~ "Placebo Unavailability (MWh)",
      variable == "Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity" ~ "Placebo Nuclear Unavailability (MWh)",
      variable == "Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity" ~ "Placebo Effective Unavailability (MWh)",
      TRUE ~ variable  # fallback
    ),
    )
  # %>% 
  #   filter(price_test >= -100)
  
  # Définir un facteur de mise à l'échelle pour que l'histogramme rentre dans l'échelle principale
  scale_factor <- max(plot_data$estimate, na.rm = TRUE) / max(hist(price_indispo_merge$gen_tot_da, plot = FALSE)$counts)
  
  #si on prend simplement le std
  #il y a une variabilité factice de la part des renouvelables
  #parce que varie significativement durant la journéé
  
  # sd_price_indispo_merge <- price_indispo_merge %>%
  # group_by(creneau) %>% 
  # dplyr::select(all_of(variables)) %>%
  # summarise(across(everything(), ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  # dplyr::select(-creneau) %>% 
  # ungroup() %>% 
  # summarise(across(everything(), ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE)))
  
  sd_price_indispo_merge <- price_indispo_merge %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(variables)) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE)))

  
  
  sd_price_indispo_merge <- data.frame(
  variable = names(sd_price_indispo_merge),
  sd_value = as.numeric(sd_price_indispo_merge))
  
  plot_data <- merge(plot_data, 
                   sd_price_indispo_merge, 
                   by = "variable")
  
  plot_data <- plot_data %>% 
    mutate(estimate_shock = estimate * sd_value,
           std_error_shock = std_error * sd_value)
  

  my_plot <- ggplot(data = plot_data) +
    geom_line(aes(x = price_test, y = estimate_shock, color = pretty_variable)) +
    geom_point(aes(x = price_test, y = estimate_shock, color = pretty_variable)) +
    geom_line(aes(x = price_test, y = 0), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(
        x = price_test, 
        ymin = estimate_shock - 1.96 * std_error_shock, 
        ymax = estimate_shock + 1.96 * std_error_shock,
        fill = pretty_variable
      ), 
      alpha = 0.2
    ) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
    labs(
      #title = paste0("Shift of the ", type, " Curve"),
      x = "Price (€)",
      y = "Quantity (MWh)",
      color = "Variable",
      fill = "Variable"
    ) +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 15),      # taille du texte
        legend.title = element_text(size = 16),     # taille du titre
        legend.key.size = unit(1.5, "cm") ,          # taille des symboles/rectangles,
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),   # taille du titre axe x
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),   # taille du titre axe y
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1),  # taille et rotation des ticks x
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12)    # taille des ticks y
  )


  if (matched == "matched"){
    # Définir un facteur de mise à l'échelle pour que l'histogramme rentre dans l'échelle principale
    scale_factor <- max(plot_data$estimate, na.rm = TRUE) / max(hist(price_indispo_merge$price, plot = FALSE)$counts)
  
    my_plot <- my_plot + 
    # Histogramme mis à l'échelle
    geom_histogram(
      data = price_indispo_merge,
      mapping = aes( x = price,  y = ..count.. * scale_factor),
      bins = 60,
      color = "black",
      fill = NA
    )
    
    # Axe secondaire
    # scale_y_continuous(
    #   name = "Price (€/GWh)",
    #   sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor, name = "Fréquence de gen_tot")
    # )
  }
  my_plot <- my_plot +
  coord_flip(xlim = c(-20, 165))

  return(my_plot)
}

```

## Using wind and solar irradiation directly for renwables




```{r}

setwd(file.path(Sys.getenv("REPLICATION_ROOT", "."), "supply_demand_curve/outputs"))
coef_supply_unmatched <- readRDS("reg_shift_result_qty_supply_unmatched_sparse_lv_natural.rds")
coef_supply_unmatched_data_natural <- data.table::rbindlist(coef_supply_unmatched)

coef_demand_unmatched <- readRDS("reg_shift_result_qty_demand_unmatched_sparse_lv_natural.rds")
coef_demand_unmatched_data_natural <- data.table::rbindlist(coef_demand_unmatched)

# unique(coef_supply_unmatched_data_natural$variable)
# colnames(coef_supply_unmatched_data_natural)
# colnames(coef_demand_unmatched_data_natural)
new_renewable_factors <- c("wind_speed_100m_supply_bis" , "global_tilted_irradiance_supply_bis", 
                           "wind_speed_100m_demand" , "global_tilted_irradiance_demand")
coef_supply_combined <- rbind(coef_supply_unmatched_data_natural%>% 
                                mutate(variable =ifelse(variable == "wind_speed_100m_supply", "wind_speed_100m_supply_bis", variable),
                                       variable =ifelse(variable == "global_tilted_irradiance_supply", 
                                                        "global_tilted_irradiance_supply_bis", variable)
                                       ),
                              coef_demand_unmatched_data_natural %>% 
                                mutate(variable =ifelse(variable == "wind_speed_100m_supply", "wind_speed_100m_demand", variable),
                                       variable =ifelse(variable == "global_tilted_irradiance_supply", "global_tilted_irradiance_demand", variable)
                                       )) %>% 
  filter(variable %in%new_renewable_factors)

unique(coef_supply_combined$variable)
  # Définir les couleurs pour chaque pretty_variable

    "Supply Solar Irradiance (W/m2)" = "gold",                     # Brown
    "Supply Wind Speed (m/s)" = "green",   # Gray
    "Demand Solar Irradiance (W/m2)" = "darkgoldenrod",                     # Brown
    "Demand Wind Speed (m/s)" = "darkgreen")
    
price_indispo_merge$wind_speed_100m_supply_bis <- price_indispo_merge$wind_speed_100m_supply
price_indispo_merge$global_tilted_irradiance_supply_bis <- price_indispo_merge$global_tilted_irradiance_supply
supply_wind_sun <- plot_shift_with_hist_qty(coef_data = coef_supply_combined, 
   variables = new_renewable_factors,
```

```{r}
setwd(file.path(Sys.getenv("REPLICATION_ROOT", "."), "supply_demand_curve/outputs"))
coef_supply_unmatched_predicted_indispo <- readRDS("reg_shift_result_qty_supply_unmatched_sparse_lv_indispo.rds")

coef_demand_unmatched_predicted_indispo <- readRDS("reg_shift_result_qty_demand_unmatched_sparse_lv_indispo.rds")
coef_demand_unmatched_predicted_indispo_data <- data.table::rbindlist(coef_demand_unmatched_predicted_indispo)

coef_supply_combined <- rbind(
  coef_supply_unmatched_data %>%
    filter(grepl("Unavailable", variable)),
  coef_supply_unmatched_predicted_indispo_data %>%
    filter(grepl("Unavailable", variable))
)
coef_demand_combined <- rbind(
  coef_demand_unmatched_data %>%
    filter(grepl("Unavailable", variable)),
  coef_demand_unmatched_predicted_indispo_data %>%
    filter(grepl("Unavailable", variable))
)
```
